scope: Responsive JSON authoring, Chakra overlap ordering and rem spacing; partial inventory choices

decisions.question: Responsive HTML format
decisions.decision: One HTML attribute per responsive property accepts plain values or JSON objects/arrays. Lit and React pass corresponding JavaScript values.
Use Chakra's generated-query ordering model for overlaps, independent of responsive-object key insertion order; preserve native exact boundary syntax.

Use rem for house spacing token values converted at a 16px reference. Token 2 becomes 0.5rem. Density remains independent of text size; theme overrides and explicit CSS lengths remain supported. Does not select additional token keys or all third-party scale values.

findings.subject: overlap ordering
findings.check: Executed pinned source in Bun, replacing memo wrapper only with identity and transpiling TypeScript.
findings.limit: Source-level comparator check only; not generated house CSS or browser validation.

findings.subject: current converter
findings.scope: Exact isolated converter extracted/transpiled/executed in Bun
findings.implication: Future shared converter must recognize valid scalar CSS rather than infer JSON from initial bracket alone; no production source changed.

findings.subject: Chakra array normalization
findings.finding: normalization loops positions and copies values only when current != null; 0 and false remain. House limits/index names require own contract, not blindly copied.

draftRules.status: Agent-prepared draft, not complete inventory approval
draftRules.arrayMapping: compact, medium, expanded, large, extraLarge; null or omitted JavaScript entries emit no new value, preserving preceding applicable values or component defaults; preserve 0 and false.
draftRules.arraySource: Pinned Chakra system.ts normalizeValue skips only null/undefined.
draftRules.conditionMapping: Band name = threshold upward; Only = named band until next threshold (last band unbounded); Down = below named threshold, with no empty compactDown; lowerToUpper = lower inclusive and upper exclusive. Complete emitted ordering and duplicate-bound equivalence need final source-to-native-range verification.
draftRules.scalarCSS: A full property-valid CSS scalar remains valid even when starting with [; do not use the existing first-character JSON guess.
draftRules.reflection: Draft follows Lit guidance: do not automatically reflect object/array property writes to attributes; retain HTML input conversion.
draftRules.containerMissing: Use native container-query matching; confirm baseline compact-value behavior explicitly in final contract.
